description: Start a company based in Ontario or British Columbia: federal (CBCA), or a BC or Ontario company. Works without an API key: then it returns the company with checkout_url, the person pays there or on page_url, and follows the company later by signing in at mapleminute.com with the contact email. With an API key the company joins that account (get_payment_link, get_company and the rest). Nothing is filed until payment. Every name, address and consent must come from the person: the consent of directors to act and the agreement to the terms are their own declarations.

agree_to_terms_and_privacy.description: The human agrees to https://mapleminute.com/terms and https://mapleminute.com/privacy. Only send true if they confirmed it.

also_register_in.description: Federal companies: also register in Manitoba or Saskatchewan (government fee and our fee in get_prices; the yearly plan then adds that province's annual return). Only if the company does business there.

also_register_in_bc.description: Only when the office is outside BC (a federal company), or for an ON company: also register in BC (BC government fee, plus the BC name approval for an Ontario company, and our fee in get_prices; the yearly plan then adds the BC annual report). No office in BC is needed, but BC requires an attorney: an individual living in BC (at the BC office where they can usually be reached) or a BC company (at its registered office), who accepts legal papers for the company there. Only if the company does business in BC.

postal_code.description: A BC postal code, like V6B 1A1.

oneOf.description: Maple Minute acts as the attorney, $19.99 a year (see get_prices).

also_register_in_ontario.description: Only when the office is outside Ontario (a federal company), or for a BC company: also register in Ontario. No government fee; our fee in get_prices. Only if the company does business in Ontario.

attorney_in.description: An attorney for service, by province code, where one is needed: Manitoba, unless its registered office is in Manitoba and a director or officer lives there; Saskatchewan, unless a director or officer lives in Saskatchewan. A person living there (or a company there), at their address there.

business_activity.description: A few words, like "coffee shop" or "software consulting".

company_phone_number.description: A Canadian phone number for the company, from us (yearly fee, see get_prices). Receive-only: texts and voicemails show in get_company.phone. Keeps the founder's own number out of business directories.

contact.description: The person we talk to about the order. Receives the receipt, documents and private order link.

directors_agreed_to_act.description: Every director is 18+, not bankrupt, and agreed to be a director. Only send true if the human confirmed it.

duns.description: Free: we request a D-U-N-S number from Dun & Bradstreet once incorporated (needed for Apple/Google developer accounts and some suppliers); usually within 30 business days.

express.description: Federal only: Corporations Canada processes within 4 hours for a $100 government fee.

financial_year_end_month.description: The company year ends on the last day of this month.

jurisdiction.description: CA: federal, name protected across Canada, also registered in the office's province; needs resident Canadian directors (at least 1, or a quarter with 4+). BC or ON: a provincial company; directors can live anywhere, the office must be in that province, no express. Moving a provincial company to federal later costs about $900 (BC) or $530 (ON) in government fees. Fees in get_prices.

name.description: Omit for a numbered company (fastest; like 1234567 Canada Inc., 1234567 B.C. Ltd. or 1234567 Ontario Inc.).

if_refused.description: If the registry refuses the name: incorporate as numbered right away, or pause and ask (answer later with choose_new_name).

name.description: For type word: the name without Inc./Ltd., e.g. "Northbound Coffee".

office.description: Registered office: public, a street address in the province, not a PO box.

province.description: Federal: Ontario (provincial registration free), Manitoba ($350 government fee), Saskatchewan ($255 government fee) or British Columbia ($350 BC government fee). For a BC or ON company it is that province.

use_our_address.description: Use our office address instead (yearly fee, see get_prices); letters from the registries and the CRA are scanned into the account. Then omit street/city/postal_code.

people.description: Everyone who is a director or owns part of the company.

address_for_service.description: Optional address where official papers can reach them, shown publicly instead of the home address. Not a PO box.

citizenship.description: Required for owners of 25% or more; private.

date_of_birth.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Required for owners of 25% or more; kept private by Corporations Canada.

director.description: Runs the company and signs for it. At least one person must be a director.

first_name.description: Legal first name, as on ID.

officer.description: Not a director but an officer (e.g. the president). The president must be a director or an officer.

owns_percent.description: Percent of the company this person owns. All people must add up to 100. Use 0 for someone who owns nothing.

province_or_state.description: Two-letter Canadian province code like BC or ON, or a state/region outside Canada.

resident_canadian.description: A Canadian citizen or permanent resident who lives in Canada. At least one director must be (a quarter of them with 4+ directors).

street.description: Home address: street number and name. Required for directors and for owners of 25% or more. Public for directors; no PO boxes.

tax_residence.description: Country where they pay income tax. Required for owners of 25% or more; private.

president_index.description: Index in people of the president; must be a director or an officer.

yearly_plan.description: We file the annual returns and changes every year (price in get_prices).
